# onlinesim-js-api

> Typed, zero-dependency JavaScript/TypeScript client for the OnlineSim API.

## Documentation Sets

- [onlinesim-js-api — full docs](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-js-api/llms-full.txt): Complete documentation of the onlinesim-js-api SDK.

## Documentation

- [Changelog](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-js-api/raw/changelog.md): Release notes of onlinesim-js-api.
- [Free numbers](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-js-api/raw/free.md): Public numbers and their SMS — client.free. No API key needed.
- [Numbers](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-js-api/raw/numbers.md): Order a number, read its SMS, close it — client.numbers.
- [Rent](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-js-api/raw/rent.md): Rent a number for days and receive every SMS sent to it — client.rent.
- [Testing](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-js-api/raw/testing.md): Test your integration offline with MockOnlineSim — no network, key or money.
- [User](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-js-api/raw/user.md): Balance, profile, payments and the webhook URL — client.user.
- [Webhooks](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-js-api/raw/webhooks.md): Receive SMS as HTTP callbacks and parse them with parseWebhook.
